scope: Exact Symbolica coefficient-extraction defect and native physical NP transport diagnosis; no full nonplanar physical fit accuracy claim.

reproducer.cause: coefficient_list uses an internal AtomField with statistical zero testing; an overflowing f64 sum produces Inconclusive, which the field treats as zero.
reproducer.exact_alternative: Atom::try_to_polynomial with AtomField.statistical_zero_test=false, followed by native to_univariate_polynomial_list

execution.method: direct rustc of the standalone Symbolica-only source linked to the official c3408e4 release artifact

native_sample.boundary_source: native recursive AMF, without numerical reference inputs
native_sample.arithmetic_control: Replaying the same exact dyadic boundary/source at 160 working digits with the unchanged 80-digit local gate preserves the endpoint defect through approximately 86 digits. This is not an arithmetic-precision limitation.
native_sample.row_clearing_certificate: All nonzero row-59 entries pass both exact polynomial cross multiplication and symbolic reconstruction. Common denominator degrees: epsilon 2, eta 10.

exact_collection_fix_validation.implementation: RustFlow selects the native Symbolica exact AtomField polynomial conversion and native polynomial grouping/flattening; no Symbolica source patch, independent collection algorithm, or numerical fallback.
exact_collection_fix_validation.artifact_scope: These diagnostic runs used the exact-collector snapshot before the final exponent preflight guard. Their recorded hashes identify that snapshot; the final guard source was separately rebuilt and validated in 2026-10-05-exact-coefficient-regressions.json.

first_step_replay.input: Previously computed native first-boundary values retained as exact dyadics; no reference values.
first_step_replay.stopping_condition: Deliberate cancellation after first accepted step.

exact_collection_fix_validation.interpretation: The original coefficient-loss defect is removed without relaxing accuracy: both replays now accept ordinary transport steps, and independently recomputed native boundary values agree exactly. The full replay reaches a predicate limit and the fresh diagnostic reaches its time limit. Neither constitutes a completed finite-epsilon evaluation or a validated Laurent fit; an uncapped native production fit is required.
